$comment: Shared input/expected vectors for VfAccordion. The TypeScript rules in accordion/state.ts and the PHP mirror in packages/razor/src/Support/AccordionState.php both run this file. resolveAccordionOpen takes `open` as undefined (spelled as an absent key here) or a boolean: the Vue reference tests `!== undefined`, and the Razor adapter maps its own null-attribute convention onto absence before the rule runs. There is deliberately no vector for a toggle, a listener or a next-state transition: the rule set holds no state, and a vector file that described one would be the first line of the disclosure state machine the plan forbids.

resolveAccordionOpen.$why: defaultOpen false is the same as absent.
The controlled prop wins over the seed, in both directions.

resolveAccordionTransition.expected: height var(--vf-motion-duration-normal) var(--vf-motion-ease-standard), opacity var(--vf-motion-duration-normal) var(--vf-motion-ease-standard)
